receiver_policy: Only the existing ActionReceiverProperties constructor changes, API34+ when no explicit state or instant-app visibility is supplied. Unpermissioned receivers private; sender-permission receivers exported with that permission still enforced. API31-33/explicit flags unchanged.
predecode_gate: Only OplusPreTileDecodeService uses standard signature/privileged android.permission.SYSTEM_CAMERA, already granted to current Camera13. Portable prepared APK retains OEM service gate. No new permission definition or grant.

source_recipe.limits: Gallery alpha12 retains alpha11 and guards the optional UAH performance hint before the first vendor call when its complete public API is unavailable. Original native drawing, media, supported OEM hints, signer, min31/target34, shared SDK/LUT/policy and engine remain unchanged. A four-minute same-signer null-object diagnostic on alpha11 passes drawing, color, Undo and Save copy; the owner confirms saved strokes and original retention. That diagnostic also skips optional VRR hints, so exact alpha12 installation and regression acceptance remain pending. Optional stylus/eyedropper are unproven; photo locking parked.
